newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Hongkong Bank increases CD programme.
newsitem.headline: Hongkong Bank increases CD programme.

text.p: Hongkong and Shanghai Bank said on Thursday it has increased the size of its certificate of deposit issuance programme to HK$20 billion from HK$15 billion to accomodate the increased size of its most recent issue.
Hongkong Bank announced earlier in the day that its recent five-year floating rate certificate of deposit issue had been raised to HK$3.5 billion from HK$2.0 billion.
The CD programme is now composed of 39 individual issues, of which four are public offerings, totalling almost HK$16 billion. Maturities range from one to 10 years, the bank said.
